items: 新增独立签到任务、固定时间计划、手动执行和运行结果记录。
每个任务使用独立凭据，并可配置独立 Webhook 与 SMTP 通知。
移除绑定用户运行事件、全局设置贡献和用户列表徽章。
修复部分社区以非 2xx 状态返回已签到业务结果时被误判为请求失败的问题。
修复库街区签到月份参数格式，并规范化持久化的设备 UUID。
新增崩坏3的米游社与 HoYoLAB 游戏内签到。
新增森空岛明日方舟与终末地、SKPORT终末地国际服、库街区鸣潮与战双帕弥什游戏内签到。
新增五个平台独立凭据、状态、签到游戏选择和用户列表聚合徽章。
将用户配置规范化为 schema v3，并保留既有米游社与 HoYoLAB 状态记录。

en-US.description: Create independent check-in tasks with local schedules, manual runs, results, and task-specific Webhook or SMTP notifications.

items: Added independent check-in tasks, fixed-time schedules, manual runs, and run results.
Each task now has independent credentials and Webhook or SMTP notifications.
Removed user-run hooks, global settings contributions, and user-list badges.
Fixed already-signed responses being reported as request failures when some communities use non-2xx HTTP status codes.
Fixed the Kuro sign-in month parameter format and normalized persisted device UUIDs.
Added in-game check-in for Honkai Impact 3rd on Miyoushe and HoYoLAB.
Added in-game check-in for Arknights and Endfield on Skland, Endfield global on SKPORT, and Wuthering Waves and Punishing: Gray Raven on Kuro.
Added independent credentials, state, game selection, and aggregated user-list badges for five platforms.
Normalized user settings to schema v3 while retaining existing Miyoushe and HoYoLAB state records.
